narr: Modest moisture remained over Otero county and storms developed on the eastern slopes of the Sacramento Mountains over the Salt Burn scar. Rainfall amounts of a half inch to 1 inch brought flash flooding to the area around Bear Canyon.
ev: A half inch to 1 inch of rain fell on the Salt Burn Scar and produced flash flooding out of Bear Canyon onto Highway 70.
lsr: Relayed by ABQ. Flash flooding observed from the Salt Fire Burn Scar stemming from Bear Canyon. See LSR issued by ABQ.
